metaTitle: Custom Cardboard Awards Recognition | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom cardboard awards recognition for eco-friendly employee appreciation. Perfect for bulk orders at PerfectImprints.com.
introHtml: Cardboard awards recognition offers a lightweight, eco-friendly alternative to traditional plaques and trophies. Ideal for companies prioritizing sustainability, these custom awards can be printed with full-color logos and personalized messages using digital or screen printing. Perfect for annual ceremonies, safety milestones, or team celebrations, cardboard awards are cost-effective for bulk orders and easy to ship. Choose from various shapes and sizes to create memorable, recyclable recognition pieces that align with your brand's green initiatives.
heroAltText: Stack of custom cardboard awards recognition plaques with colorful printed designs and company logos
